# garage_buckets (Data Source)

Lists every bucket of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_buckets" "all" {}

output "bucket_names" {
  value = flatten(data.garage_buckets.all.buckets[*].global_aliases)
}
```
